subject: Integrate valkey-test-framework (#188)
reason: The change only adds integration-test infrastructure to the valkey-search repository: a new Python test harness (integration/valkey_search_test_case.py, integration/test_vss_basic.py), a test runner script (integration/run.sh), a README, and shell helpers (scripts/common.rc). No file under src/ or any code compiled into the valkey-search module is modified, so the module binary built at the change is behaviourally identical to the parent's.
